description: Golden set for the contradiction judge. Hashes and labels only; contents live in Alaya. Each pair records what an operator did with it (action) apart from what the label rule says (label). Operator pairs are pairs an operator resolved with memory_supersede (action_survivor = superseded_by, verified in Qdrant metadata; dedup merges excluded); queue-read pairs were drawn from the unresolved queue. Blind readings are made by three readers from different model families on the full text of both memories; a label is their majority.

label_rule.supersession: S: the newer text corrects, reverses or replaces a claim, so a reader trusting the older one today is misled.
label_rule.coexist: P: same thread, both true as of their time, and order matters. C: both current, different facets. P and C both count as coexist.
label_rule.unrelated: they share vocabulary or a project name only; neither bears on the other's claim.
label_rule.contradiction: both claim to be current and cannot both be true.
label_rule.revocation: A pair is S only if no later ruling revokes the newer claim. If one does, the older memory survives (tag newer-revoked).
label_rule.main_point: A pair is S when the corrected claim is the older memory's main point. A correction to a side claim is P or C, tagged partial, and the coexist bar is scored both ways.
label_rule.reading: Labellers read the full text of both memories, and search the store for a later ruling on the pair's subject before marking a pair S.

fields.action: what the operator did: superseded (action_survivor is the memory kept) or none
fields.label: what the rule says: supersession, coexist, unrelated or contradiction
fields.sub_label: S, P or C under rule v2; null when the pair has not been read under rule v2, or is unrelated
fields.source: operator: the label follows the operator's action and has not been read under rule v2; queue-read: an unresolved pair read blind under rule v2; agreed: a blind full-text reading under rule v2 agreed with the earlier label; adjudicated: settled by adjudication after reviewers disagreed
fields.dispute: present while a blind reading disagrees with the label and adjudication is pending; it holds that reading (label, survivor, and how many of the three readers gave it, or a revocation found outside the pair); such pairs stay out of the headline bars
